phase_plan.range_rule: descending fails; semantic-gap plans are data

representation.kind: zero-terminated named uint8 data walked by one non-LTO Island leaf
representation.selection: canonical plan pointer; no duplicate selector ids

assembler_leaf_abi.invariant: Assembler declarations establish provenance; the final ELF derives the complete linked C-called leaf set. Every discovered surface has an ABI policy or the build is red. CRC and the runtime-overlay L65E entry additionally prove their real caller register setup from structured relocations and dataflow.

rtov_crc_mem_callers.invariant: Every final-ELF relocation to rtov_crc_mem is owned, is a direct JSR, and locally establishes pointer in __rc2/__rc3 plus length in A/X. No caller class is inferred from the Leaf comment.

c2_append_plan_walk.policy: C->ASM: canonical plan pointer __rc2/__rc3; context __rc4/__rc5; result A; ASM->C c2_overlay_call: slot A; context __rc2/__rc3

l65e_emit_bcode_ordinal.policy: ASM->ASM: validated BCODE A/X; output through emit; void

lisp65_error_overlay_entry.policy: runtime-overlay dispatcher->ASM: context pointer __rc2/__rc3; status A

lisp65_f011_mount_token_op.policy: C->ASM: mode A; boolean result A

lisp65_f011_scratch_buffer.policy: C->ASM: offset A/X; write mode __rc2; boolean result A

lisp65_mod_adjust_tagged.policy: C->ASM: tagged remainder A/X; tagged divisor __rc2/__rc3; result A/X

rtov_crc_mem.policy: C->ASM: pointer __rc2/__rc3; length A/X; result A/X; Z=0

rtov_dma_submit_wait.policy: C->ASM: no arguments; no result; interrupt state restored

vm_bank3_boot_stage_entry.policy: resident->ASM and ASM->C: no arguments; status in A

vm_boot_overlay_chain_commit.policy: ASM->C ov_crc16: pointer __rc2/__rc3; length A/X; result A/X

canonical_detail_seam.model_correction: Relocation identity is (target section, resolved addend); a local function name need not survive as the relocation symbol.

final_island_identity.extraction_rule: actual final section extracted only from a disposable ELF copy

preinstallation_island.claim_limit: Static direct-control and retained-relocation proof. Before READY, the sole Bank-0 data-reference exception is the machine-proven complete-Island zero wipe used to erase or fail-close the destination; no Island-owned value is consumed and no unguarded code is entered.

proof.permanent_rule: Every C2 probe imports and executes this complete-domain gate; new direct obj domains must be added to the obj.h-backed emitter.
